title: RBI holds repo rate at 6.25%, shifts stance to neutral
text: The Reserve Bank of India kept the benchmark repo rate unchanged at 6.25% and changed its policy stance to neutral, citing easing inflation.

title: RBI keeps key rate steady, signals data-dependent path
text: India's central bank left the repo rate at 6.25 percent, adopting a neutral stance and saying future moves will depend on incoming inflation data.

title: Monetary policy: RBI stays put, rupee firms
text: Following the RBI's decision to hold rates and move to a neutral stance, the rupee strengthened against the dollar in early trade.

title: India beat Australia by 6 wickets in second ODI
text: India chased down the target with six wickets in hand to level the one-day series against Australia, powered by a century from the opener.

title: Opener's ton seals ODI win over Australia
text: A composed hundred guided India to a comfortable victory over Australia in the second one-day international, squaring the three-match series.

title: Series level: India edge Australia in Rajkot
text: India defeated Australia by six wickets at Rajkot to level the ODI series 1-1 ahead of the decider.

title: Monsoon reaches Kerala coast, IMD confirms onset
text: The India Meteorological Department declared the onset of the southwest monsoon over Kerala, two days ahead of the normal date.

title: Southwest monsoon hits Kerala early this year
text: Rains lashed the Kerala coast as the IMD announced an early onset of the southwest monsoon, raising hopes for the kharif crop.

title: Kerala braces as monsoon arrives ahead of schedule
text: With the monsoon arriving early over Kerala, authorities issued advisories for coastal districts amid heavy rainfall.

title: SEBI tightens disclosure norms for listed firms
text: The market regulator SEBI approved stricter disclosure requirements for listed companies, including faster reporting of material events.

title: SEBI board clears rules on faster material-event reporting
text: SEBI's board approved amendments requiring companies to disclose material developments within a tighter window, aiming to improve transparency.

title: Regulator overhauls corporate disclosure framework
text: In a bid to protect investors, SEBI overhauled its disclosure framework, mandating quicker and more detailed reporting from listed entities.
